newsitem.title: USA: Workgroup Tech sees Q1 loss with charge.
newsitem.headline: Workgroup Tech sees Q1 loss with charge.

text.p: Workgroup Technology Corp said on Thursday it expects to report a net loss for the first quarter of fiscal 1998 ended June 30 of approximately $1.7 million to $2.0 million, or $0.21 to $0.24 per share.

This loss includes a one-time charge of between $300,000 and $400,000 for the fiscal quarter relating to management changes as well as other organizational changes that the company previously announced, it said.
The company said its revenue for the first quarter of fiscal year 1998 was approximately $1.8 million.
Workgroup said it expects to release its first quarter results on July 24.

James Carney, Workgroup's chief executive officer, said in a statement that software license revenue was lower than expected in the quarter, due to a delay in the release of the comapany's products and a turnover in its sales organization.
Workgroup provides client/server product data software used to manage product lifecycle from design and development through market feedback.
